verdict.rationale: Superset orchestrates third-party CLI coding agents in isolated worktrees, with terminals, setup/teardown scripts, diff review and PR creation. An orchestration platform could plausibly ship a test-and-validate gate, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the pack shows Superset itself generating or running tests, or gating a proposed change on test results; any such behavior would come from the underlying agent and is not evidenced here.
